mapper.select: SELECT chunk_id, doc_id, seq, content, embedding, content_hash, model, create_time, update_time FROM kb_chunk WHERE doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY seq ASC

SELECT c.chunk_id, c.doc_id, c.seq, c.content, c.embedding, c.content_hash, c.model, c.create_time, c.update_time, d.title AS doc_title FROM kb_chunk c INNER JOIN kb_doc d ON d.doc_id = c.doc_id AND d.enabled = 1 WHERE c.embedding IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.doc_id ASC, c.seq ASC
